q1_issues.issue: The flat (Member sk_vampire_1 bat) asserts tenselessly that the vampire is a bat, but a flat result atom is licensed only as half of the resultative dual-emit, and neither half of the licensing structure is present — no reified result state with Experiencer, no (Result <event> <state>) link.

The resulting kind is encoded twice in incompatible ways: 'a bat' is already a separate witness sk_bat_1 attached by the Into oblique, so the extra flat atom predicates bat-hood of the vampire while a distinct bat individual also stands.

q2_gaps: resultative with a nominal / kind-denoting result on an intransitive change-of-state verb ('transformed into a bat', 'turned into X', 'became a doctor') — the resultative section covers only an adjectival state result on a transitive object and a motion result, so nothing specifies how the resulting KIND of a metamorphosis is attached, or whether the result NP is a witness or a predicate
notes: Definite subject typing, event class, Past, and Patient for the intransitive change-of-state subject are all correct. (Into <event> <bat>) is licensed by the preposition-named-oblique rule (the head is the preposition actually used) since 'into a bat' answers neither 'where' nor 'whither'; Goal is stated only for motion results, so the oblique choice is defensible and the flat atom is the actual defect.
